name: Content Calendar CSV Generator
description: Generate a ready-to-use social media content calendar as a CSV — pick a month, add your posts, and download for any spreadsheet app.
body:
Preview

Your generated calendar will preview here.

Generates a template with placeholders — fill in the topic, caption and status per day.
howto: Pick the month for your calendar.
Choose the main platform and the content theme for the month.
Preview the CSV in the right panel — every day of the month is a row.
Download it and open in Excel, Google Sheets or your planner.
features: Full month of daily content slots
Platform and theme fields applied to every row
Pre-built columns: date, platform, theme, topic, caption, media, status, notes

faq.q: What columns does the calendar include?
faq.a: Date, weekday, platform, theme, topic, caption, media type, status and notes. Empty fields are ready for you to fill in.
Pick one platform per generation run, then generate again with a different platform — or choose 'All platforms' and label each row as you go.

faq.q: Does it plan my content for me?
faq.a: It builds the skeleton and prompts you with a topic idea per day based on your theme. You fill in the actual captions and media.

faq.q: Where do I open the CSV?
faq.a: Any spreadsheet app — Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers or Airtable all import the comma-separated file directly.
